Fast, heavily armed and notoriously elusive, Scharnhorst became one of Germany’s most feared warships during World War II. From Atlantic raids to Arctic convoy battles, she earned a reputation for aggressive action before her final battle at the North Cape in 1943.

Swift and aggressive, the Sauro-class destroyers served the Regia Marina across the Mediterranean during World War II. Designed for high-speed attacks and escort duties, they became a constant threat in the fierce naval battles that dominated the region.

One of the most powerful battleships ever built by France, Richelieu combined heavy firepower, speed and advanced design in a sleek modern warship. Serving across the Atlantic and Indian Oceans during World War II, she became a symbol of the reborn French Navy.

One of the most decorated battleships in Royal Navy history, HMS Warspite fought across the Atlantic, Mediterranean and Pacific during World War II. Renowned for her resilience and devastating firepower, she earned a legendary reputation after surviving heavy damage and returning repeatedly to the front line.

A veteran of two world wars, USS Nevada survived the attack on Pearl Harbor before returning to fight across the Pacific. Tough, heavily armed and famously resilient, she became one of the most enduring battleships in United States Navy history.

community_item_data.item_description: The Y'm-bhi appear to be not a people, but a class of being, mortals reshaped by ancient methods far beyond our understanding. Many are former explorers, our comrades and countrymen, their bodies reclaimed after death and reassembled into obedient forms. Flesh is stitched and repurposed, sometimes capriciously, producing laborers and guards that are human only in form.
The Shoggoth Worm dwells deep beneath the earth, burrowing through soil and stone with the terrible persistence of the aeons, rarely surfacing unless disturbed.
"There is no nobility left in the wars we are fighting, no honor in being a soldier. I seek a true and honest purpose, even if it is base. Better to be selfish than a hypocrite."

Like bark bent into human form, the legends name it Ulth-Sha’korr, “Walker Between Roots” and warn that it appears only after the forest has been addressed improperly: a tree cut without offering, a stone overturned that should have remained dreaming. Other, darker legends say its purpose is mere cruelty.
"There is a dead man in Seville whose life I took; and I do not regret the dagger-thrust. As I cannot return, I must make a new life for myself unlike that of a lady."

Those who have beheld The Haunter of the Dark speak first of its eye: a single, luminous stare that pierces the mind rather than the flesh. To meet that gaze, even briefly, is to feel one’s thoughts unravel; to endure it is to invite collapse, as the will fails and the body soon follows.
"I must atone for my sins. The Scriptures teach us to make ploughshares of swords, yet I watched as the Word was used to make swords of crosses. Perhaps in the wilderness I will find salvation."
"I have grown weary of taking lives in the name of distant lords who know nothing of our lives. I do not care about gold, but I care about the freedom it can bring me."

I first visited Scovara when I was just an imp. My memories are hazy, as all memories of our younger days tend to be, but I do remember the intense heat from the great vats of salsa murder. I also remember this recipe - a favourite of my chef at the time, and one that remains a nostalgic favourite of my own all these years later!

The pungent root, gahlik, wasn't always as widespread as it is today. Once a rare and humble crop from the region of Clovenna, it was gradually transformed over centuries of careful cultivation: the sourness was bred out, the hardiness improved and the tiny bulbs grew into the bulbous cloves that gave the islands their name!

Down in the slightly salty earth of the islands of Pommora, rich tamato fruits grow in abundance and have become the base ingredient for many modern dishes. Watching our factories harvest these crops en masse, I was inspired by the intricately complex machinery to create something simple and humbling.
